{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_ages = sales['customer_age'][sales['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

print("Mean age of customers (excluding -1 values):", mean_age)"}
